# Visibility cases: <name> <file> <commands...>
# Commands run after the file is opened (startup visibility applied):
#   L<n>  move to line n (any command other than TAB/S-TAB ends a cycle)
#   T     TAB (org-cycle)
#   S     S-TAB (org-shifttab, global cycling)
# "-" means no command: the startup visibility itself.
content         content.org     -
content-tab1    content.org     L3 T
content-tab2    content.org     L3 T T
content-tab3    content.org     L3 T T T
content-tabB    content.org     L8 T
content-tabB2   content.org     L8 T T
content-stab1   content.org     S
content-stab2   content.org     S S
content-stab3   content.org     S S S
show2           show2.org       -
show2-tab       show2.org       L4 T
show2-stab      show2.org       S
visprops        visprops.org    -
visprops-tabA   visprops.org    L2 T
visprops-tabA2  visprops.org    L2 T T
visprops-tabF   visprops.org    L11 T
visprops-tabH   visprops.org    L21 T
visprops-tabH2  visprops.org    L21 T T
showall         showall.org     -
showall-tabB    showall.org     L14 T
showall-tabB2   showall.org     L14 T T
showall-tabA    showall.org     L2 T
showall-tabA2   showall.org     L2 T T
showall-drawer  showall.org     L3 T
showall-archive showall.org     L11 T
showall-stab    showall.org     S
sep             sep.org         -
sep-tab         sep.org         L2 T
sep-tab2        sep.org         L2 T T
nested          nested.org      -
nested-tab      nested.org      L4 T
nested-tab2     nested.org      L4 T T
skip            skip.org        -
skip-tab        skip.org        L2 T
skip-tab2       skip.org        L2 T T
everything      everything.org  -
everything-stab everything.org  S

blocks-block    blocks.org      L9 T
blocks-drawer   blocks.org      L6 T
